ONCOGLOBAL EXPENSE POLICY (FY 2025-26)
TRANSACTION LIMIT: Rs. 150 per transaction. Any single expense above Rs. 150 is automatically flagged for compliance review. This applies to meals, refreshments, and gifts.
EXPENSE CATEGORIES AND LIMITS: - Meal / Refreshment: Rs. 150 per transaction (flag above this) - Travel (cab/auto/local): Actuals, no separate limit. Receipt required above Rs. 200. - Train / Flight: Must use company travel portal. Economy only unless prior approval. - Hotel / Accommodation: Pre-approved accommodation list. Max Rs. 3000/night tier-2 cities, Rs. 5000/night tier-1 cities. - Samples: Logged separately in sample tracking system — not as expense. - CME / Events: Prior approval required. Max sponsorship as per annual plan.
GST TREATMENT (India 2024): - Meals (restaurant): 5% GST. Total amount = pre-tax × 1.05. SGST 2.5% + CGST 2.5%. - Hotel Rs. 1001-7500/night: 12% GST. SGST + CGST 6% each. - Hotel above Rs. 7500/night: 18% GST. - CME / Conference registration: 18% GST. - Air travel (economy): 5% GST. Business class: 12%. - Non-AC train, hotel below Rs. 1000: 0% GST. - Pharma samples: 0% GST (exempt).
SUBMISSION TIMELINE: Expenses must be submitted within 7 working days of incurrence via the OncoGlobal expense portal. Delayed submissions require manager approval.
REIMBURSEMENT: Approved expenses reimbursed by the 10th of following month via salary account.
AUDIT: All flagged expenses (above Rs. 150) are reviewed by Compliance team monthly. Please maintain physical receipts for 3 years.

ONCOGLOBAL EXPENSE POLICY — Simple Language Mein
LIMIT: Ek transaction mein Rs. 150 se zyada nahi — warna compliance flag ho jaata hai. Matlab agar lunch Rs. 200 ka hua, system mein automatically flag aayega.
KISME KITNA: - Khana-peena (meal): Rs. 150 tak — isse zyada pe flag - Local travel (cab/auto): Jo bhi actual hua, receipt chahiye Rs. 200 se zyada pe - Train/flight: Company portal se book karo, economy class - Hotel: Tier-1 city (Mumbai, Delhi) mein max Rs. 5000/raat, tier-2 mein Rs. 3000 - Samples: Expense mein nahi aate — alag system mein log hote hain - CME/events: Pehle approval lena hoga
GST KA KYA KAREN: - Restaurant mein lunch: 5% GST. Agar bill Rs. 450 hai, toh tax Rs. 21.43 (SGST Rs. 10.71 + CGST Rs. 10.71) - Hotel (Rs. 1001-7500): 12% GST - Hotel (Rs. 7500+): 18% GST - CME registration: 18% GST - Samples ya 1000 se kam ka hotel: 0% GST
KAISE SUBMIT KARO: 7 working days ke andar expense portal mein daalo. Deri hogi toh manager ki approval chahiye.
REIMBURSEMENT: Agले mahine ki 10 tarikh tak salary account mein aayega.
IMPORTANT: Rs. 150+ wale sabhi expenses compliance team dekhti hai. Receipts 3 saal tak rakhna!
